note: Builds content/audio/manifest.json: the selected samples of the supplied FMOD banks per game event (complete
redistribution: NOT cleared: Enlisted sound-mod banks supplied without reuse permission; samples are git-ignored (content/audio/samples) and extracted locally from the user's banks

shot_m1_garand.note: rifle-bank "m1" family (semi-automatic, no loop): taken as the M1 Garand; the name alone does not prove it

shot_m1c_garand.note: same rifle as the M1 Garand: shares its family on purpose

shot_m1_carbine.note: no M1 Carbine firing recording exists in the banks (only its reload foley); the automatic-bank "m1" family is used as a distinct placeholder - replace when a carbine recording is available

shot_m3_grease_gun.note: the automatic bank's M3 family (M3 grease gun)

shot_fg42.note: plain fg42 family (fg42_m2_* is another labelled variant, not used)

shot_m1918a2_bar.note: m1918 family (BAR), not the browning_auto_5 shotgun

shot_bazooka_m9.note: labelled M1 bazooka: an approximation for the M9

shot_m2hb.note: mounted-bank 12_7mm_m2 (12_7mm_browning50_* is a second candidate, not used)

pak_fire.note: no PaK 40 recording; the 7.5 cm KwK 40 (the PaK 40's tank-gun relative, same calibre and cartridge) is used instead of the 76mm_pak36 family

flak_fire.note: 8.8 cm Flak 36 recordings stand in for the Flak 18

reload_kar98k.note: stripper-clip reload; stages are not ordered by audition

clip_m1_garand.note: en-bloc clip: played when the clip seats

reload_mg42.note: belt; stages are not ordered by audition

bolt.note: generic rifle-bolt foley for bolt actions (Kar98k / ZF39)

shot_kar98k_zf39_far.note: the Kar98k's distant family: the scope does not change the report

shot_m1_garand_far.note: no distant recording of this rifle: the bank's generic distant rifle shot

shot_m1c_garand_far.note: no distant recording of this rifle: the bank's generic distant rifle shot

shot_m1_carbine_far.note: no distant recording of this rifle: the bank's generic distant rifle shot

shot_stg44_far.note: no distant recording of this gun: the bank's generic distant automatic shot

shot_m3_grease_gun_far.note: no distant recording of this gun: the bank's generic distant automatic shot

shot_fg42_far.note: no distant recording of this gun: the bank's generic distant automatic shot

shot_m1918a2_bar_far.note: no distant recording of this gun: the bank's generic distant automatic shot

shot_mg42_far.note: no distant recording of this gun: the bank's generic distant automatic shot

shot_m2hb_far.note: no distant recording of this gun: the bank's generic distant automatic shot

tank_17pdr.note: no 17-pounder recording: the US 76 mm M1 tank gun (the nearest Allied 76 mm tank gun) stands in

tank_88.note: KwK 36: the tank version of the 8.8 cm Flak - shares the Flak 36 family on purpose (no KwK 36 recording)

bolt_close.note: generic rifle bolt closing: second half of the bolt cycle after each Kar98k / ZF39 shot

clip_in.note: generic: one round pressed into a bolt-action magazine (ZF39 single loading, Kar98k top-off)

belt.note: generic LMG belt loading (M2HB, tank MGs)

reload_m1c_garand.note: same rifle as the M1 Garand

clip_m1c_garand.note: same en-bloc clip as the M1 Garand

step_water.note: one wading stride each (~1.2 s plus a water tail); only used below the water level
